description: This file defines API routes for managing categories in an e-commerce backend, including CRUD operations, listing, and activation/deactivation of categories.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Creates a new category with provided details, accessible only by admin role.

methods.name: GET /list
methods.description: Fetches all active categories for store display.

methods.name: GET /:id
methods.description: Fetches a specific category by ID, including its products.

methods.name: PUT /:id
methods.description: Updates category details, ensuring slug uniqueness.

methods.name: PUT /:id/active
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a category, disabling products if deactivated.

methods.name: DELETE /delete/:id
methods.description: Deletes a category by ID, admin only.
